div.head: Af 39
div.ab: XXXVI. Gif hwa on ciorlisces monnes flette gefeohte, gebete mid VI scll' ðam ciorle.
XXXVI. Gif hwa on cierlisces monnes flette gefeohte, mid syx scill. gebete ðam ceorle.
Si quis in ceorlisces mannes flette gefeohte (id est in rusticani hominis domus area pugnet), quinque sol. emendet ipsi rustico.
{XXXVI} Gif hwa cierlisces monnes flette gefeohte, mid syx scill gebete ðam ceorle.
If someone fights in a ceorl’s house, let him recompense the ceorl with six shillings.
If anyone fights in the house of a commoner, he shall pay the commoner six shillings compensation.
If anyone fights in the house of a ceorl, he is to pay six shillings compensation to the ceorl.
Wenn jemand im Hause eines gemeinfreien Mannes ficht, büsse er dem Gemeinfreien mit 6 Schill.
If someone fights in the house of a common freeman, let him pay the common freeman 6 shillings.

note.label: ramification of
note.quote: four of five Alfredian uses of 'gefeohtan' are scattered ramifications of Ine's law on fighting before the privileged

note.label: same penalty, extended
note.quote: His penalty of six shillings for fighting on a ceorl's 'floor' was the same as Ine's, but this is one of several laws that went on to fix bigger sums

note.label: cf. (wergeld enumerations)
note.quote: Alfred enumerated the wergelds ... five times as against Ine's once (n. 80)

note.label: compare
note.quote: Compare rulings against fighting in public in Hloþhere and Eadric §7 to §9 [L11–13] and Ine §6.
